final: WITH ratios AS (SELECT order_item_id, derived_product_cost * 1.0 / derived_total_cost AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items), per_item AS (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM ratios GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio, AVG(n_lines) AS avg_lines_per_order_item FROM per_item
